Shares in
Donald Trump
's media company jumped more than 60 percent in pre-market trading Monday, following an assassination attempt on the former president over the weekend.
Trump Media & Technology Group's (TMTG) stock was valued at $50.14 per share at 4:11 a.m. ET ahead of markets opening on the first day of trading since Trump was shot at a rally in Pennsylvania on Saturday. The stock, which trades under the ticker symbol DJT, closed Friday at $30.88.
Minutes into
Trump's speech
at the rally, loud popping
noises were heard
as Trump appeared to clutch his ear and fall to the ground. When he stood back up,
surrounded by Secret
Service agents, blood ran down the side of the former president's face and he was led off stage. The would-be assassin, who was shot dead by the Secret Service, has since been identified as 20-year-old Thomas Matthew Crooks.
"I was shot with a bullet that pierced the upper part of my right ear. I knew immediately that something was wrong in that I heard a
whizzing sound, shots
, and immediately felt the bullet ripping through the skin," the
former president
said in a post on Truth Social. "Much bleeding took place, so I realized then what was happening."
Republican presidential candidate former President Donald Trump is rushed offstage during a rally on July 13, 2024 in Butler, Pennsylvania. Butler County district attorney Richard Goldinger said the shooter is dead after injuring former U.S....
Republican presidential candidate former President Donald Trump is rushed offstage during a rally on July 13, 2024 in Butler, Pennsylvania. Butler County district attorney Richard Goldinger said the shooter is dead after injuring former U.S. President Donald Trump, killing one audience member and injuring another in the shooting.
More
Anna Moneymaker/Getty Images
TMTG is the parent company of social-media platform Truth Social and is majority owned by Trump.
"I thank God President Trump survived the assassination attempt and is now safe," TMTG CEO
Devin Nunes
said in a statement on Saturday.
"The situation demands a fast, thorough federal investigation to determine all the circumstances of this cowardly attack and to identify if any additional persons were involved. I also call for the federal government to provide any security resources requested by President Trump to guarantee his safety," the statement added.
Nunes also offered his "deepest sympathies" to the family of
Corey Comperatore
, a rallygoer who was killed in the shooting while protecting his family from the bullets, and to two other attendees who were injured.
Shares in the TMTG
had been plunging
since it began trading in March, amid operational challenges, legal woes, and competition from other prominent social media platforms.
In May, TMTG reported
a first-quarter net loss of $327.6 million
.
"Truth Social is in a unique place in stock market history, as it's hard to remember one stock being so directly tied to any other presidential candidate to seek office," Alex Beene, a financial literacy instructor at the University of Tennessee at Martin previously told
Newsweek
.
Other financial experts have likened the company's performance on the financial market to that of "
meme stocks
" such as GameStop and AMC.
"Meme stocks thrive on attention," Jay Ritter, a professor of finance at the University of Florida, told
Newsweek
.
Update: This story was updated at 5:35 a.m. ET with additional information.
